edrin_first.speaker: Edrin
edrin_first.text: Sister Maren? Light keep you. I'm Edrin. I've been sent to look after you while you're at Hollowmere.

edrin_first.speaker: Edrin
edrin_first.text: I aired the room out myself. The damp gets into everything here. Even the hymnals.

edrin_first.speaker: Edrin
edrin_first.text: You've been here before? Of course. You'd have been very small. Forgive me.

edrin_first.speaker: Edrin
edrin_first.text: They say there's no hurry about the Rite. Rest first. I'll be just down the hall if you need an extra pair of hands.
Edrin bows, a little too low, and goes.

crow_first.text: A crow sits on the sill. The window is shut.

crow_first.speaker: Crow
crow_first.text: You've grown. You still tuck your thumbs in when you're frightened.

crow_first.speaker: Crow
crow_first.text: The acolyte is kind. Kind people hold doors very carefully.

crow_first.speaker: Crow
crow_first.text: When you go down there... don't close it behind you. Not yet.

crow_first.speaker: Crow
crow_first.text: Someone always sees me. You do.

crow_repeat.speaker: Crow
crow_repeat.text: I'm still here. I'm always a little bit here.

table.text: A writing table. Someone has scratched out every third word of the prayer pinned above it.

drawer.text: Candle stubs, each one burned down to exactly the same line.

bed.text: The sheets are turned down. On the pillow, a pressed lily of the Order, still perfectly white.

mirror.text: A cloth hangs over the mirror. It has been nailed down at the corners.

portrait.text: A Lychkin holder, painted in full vestments. The face has been painted over in white. Carefully.

cabinet_warning.text: A reliquary cabinet, chained shut. Something inside shifts its weight against the doors.

cabinet_warning.speaker: Maren
cabinet_warning.text: The priests should have the key to this.

cabinet_open.text: The saint inside has been folded to fit.

gate_lily.text: An Order lily in a stone cup by the gate. Its petals have gone the colour of tallow.

gate_cathedral.text: Beyond the wall, the cathedral. No windows are lit. It looks closer than it should.

gate_bellrope.text: A bell rope, cut cleanly at shoulder height.

edrin_arrival.speaker: Edrin
edrin_arrival.text: Sister Maren? Light keep you. I'm Edrin. I've been sent to look after you.

edrin_arrival.speaker: Edrin
edrin_arrival.text: You'll want to be out of the cold. The damp gets into everything here. Even the hymnals.

edrin_arrival.speaker: Edrin
edrin_arrival.text: You've been here before? Of course. You'd have been very small. Forgive me.

hall_hooks.text: A row of coat hooks. One still holds a child's coat, far too small and far too clean.

hall_hymnboard.text: A hymn board. The numbers have been taken down and stacked face-down beneath it.

edrin_goodnight.speaker: Edrin
edrin_goodnight.text: This is yours. I aired it out myself.

edrin_goodnight.speaker: Edrin
edrin_goodnight.text: There's... a custom, the first night. The door is locked until the morning bell. I'll let you out myself.

edrin_goodnight.speaker: Edrin
edrin_goodnight.text: I'm sorry. I know how it sounds.

edrin_goodnight.speaker: Maren
edrin_goodnight.text: It's all right. I remember the custom.

room_key_turns.text: The key turns. He waits a moment on the other side before he goes.

crow_room_arrival.text: Something taps at the glass. Then it is on the sill, inside, and the glass is still whole.

crow_room_first.speaker: Crow
crow_room_first.text: You still tuck your thumbs in when you're frightened.

crow_room_first.speaker: Crow
crow_room_first.text: He locked it gently. They always do it gently.

crow_room_first.speaker: Crow
crow_room_first.text: I can keep this moment for you, if you like. I keep all of them.

crow_room_repeat_1.speaker: Crow
crow_room_repeat_1.text: Still here. I'm always a little bit here.

crow_room_repeat_2.speaker: Crow
crow_room_repeat_2.text: You used to hum when you counted stairs. You're doing it now.

crow_room_repeat_3.speaker: Crow
crow_room_repeat_3.text: Every door in this house remembers your hands.

crow_saved.speaker: Crow
crow_saved.text: Kept. I've had a lot of practice holding on to things.

room_prayer.text: The Order's evening prayer, pinned above the table: "We obey, we endure, we give, and so the Light is kept." Someone has scratched out every third word.

room_sill_carving.text: Small letters cut into the sill, at a child's eye height: "Give first. Then hold on. Then do as you're told, last of all, and someone will come to sit with you."

candle_plaque_obey.text: A candle in an iron cup. Carved beneath it: OBEY.

candle_plaque_endure.text: A candle in an iron cup. Carved beneath it: ENDURE.

candle_plaque_give.text: A candle in an iron cup. Carved beneath it: GIVE.

candles_wrong.text: The flames lean toward the door, all three at once, and go out.

candles_right.text: The flames stand very straight. Behind the cloth, a nail drops to the floor. Then another.

room_mirror_open.text: The cloth falls. There is no glass behind it, only a low passage, and cold air.

room_feather.text: A black feather on the sill. It leaves no dust on your fingers, though it should.
